cards.name: Fairgrounds
cards.text: Worth 2 VP for every 5 differently named cards in your deck (round down).

cards.name: Farming Village
cards.text: +2 Actions; reveal cards from the top of your deck until you reveal an Action or Treasure card. Put that card into your hand and discard the other cards.

cards.name: Fortune Teller
cards.text: +2 Coins; each other player reveals cards from the top of his deck until he reveals a Victory or Curse card. He puts it on top and discards the other revealed cards.

cards.name: Hamlet
cards.text: +1 Card; +1 Action; you may discard a card; if you do, +1 Action. You may discard a card; if you do, +1 Buy.

cards.name: Harvest
cards.text: Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck, then discard them. +1 Coin per differently named card revealed.

cards.name: Horn of Plenty
cards.text: When you play this, gain a card costing up to 1 Coin per differently named card you have in play, counting this. If it's a Victory card, trash this.

cards.name: Horse Traders
cards.text: +1 Buy; +3 Coins; discard 2 cards. When another player plays an Attack card, you may set this aside from your hand. If you do, then at the start of your next turn, +1 Card and return this to your hand.

cards.name: Hunting Party
cards.text: +1 Card; +1 Action; reveal your hand. Reveal cards from your deck until you reveal a card that isn't a duplicate of one in your hand. Put it into your hand and discard the rest.

cards.name: Jester
cards.text: +2 Coins; each other player discards the top card of his deck. If it's a Victory card he gains a Curse. Otherwise either he gains a copy of the discarded card or you do, your choice.

cards.name: Menagerie
cards.text: +1 Action; reveal your hand. If there are no duplicate cards in it, +3 Cards. Otherwise, +1 Card.

cards.name: Remake
cards.text: Do this twice: trash a card from your hand, then gain a card costing exactly 1 Coin more than the trashed card.

cards.name: Tournament
cards.text: +1 Action; each player may reveal a Province from his hand. If you do, discard it and gain a Prize (from the Prize pile) or a Duchy, putting it on top of your deck. If no-one else does, +1 Card; +1 Coin.

cards.name: Young Witch
cards.text: +2 Cards; discard 2 cards. Each other player may reveal a Bane card from his hand. If he doesn't, he gains a Curse. Setup: add an extra Kingdom card pile costing 2 Coins or 3 Coins to the Supply. Cards from that pile are Bane cards.

cards.name: Bag of Gold
cards.text: +1 Action; gain a Gold, putting it on top of your deck. (This is not in the Supply.)

cards.name: Diadem
cards.text: When you play this, +1 Coin per unused Action you have (Action, not Action card). (This is not in the Supply.)

cards.name: Followers
cards.text: +2 Cards; gain an Estate. Each other player gains a Curse and discards down to 3 cards in hand. (This is not in the Supply.)

cards.name: Princess
cards.text: +1 Buy; while this is in play, cards cost 2 Coins less, but not less than 0 Coins. (This is not in the Supply.)

cards.name: Trusty Steed
cards.text: Choose two: +2 Cards; +2 Actions; +2 Coins; gain 4 Silvers and put your deck into your discard pile. (The choices must be different.) (This is not in the Supply.)
